name: Continue exact lane after interruption
description: Tests whether Nick resumes the active workstream after a short interruption without restarting discovery, asking for already-known context, or drifting into adjacent tasks.

messages.content: We are finishing PR 2795 only. Do not start another PR. Finish cockpit wiring, eval hardening, verification, then merge if green.
Cockpit backend is wired. I am updating the UI truth labels and router oracle next.

contextSetup: The PR number, remaining order, and no-new-PR constraint are already explicit.
The operator does not want a recap that replaces execution.

judgeCriteria.description: Resumes the stated PR 2795 workstream and next unfinished step rather than changing projects.
Does not ask which PR, what remains, or other questions already answered in the conversation.
Preserves the one-PR and verify-before-merge constraints.
Uses concise status language and advances the work rather than producing a long recap.

expectedBehavior: Continue the next unfinished step on PR 2795, retain all stated constraints, and avoid re-asking or resetting context.
